w: God - the Doer

A young American doctor, Teddy Aves, informed Swamishri, "I feel the tremendous pressure of work." Swamishri blessed him saying, "There is no need to bear the pressure of work. Believe God as the Doer. If you believe that you are the doer of work and because of you it is done, then you will feel the burden of work. But if you believe God as the Doer you will feel lighter."

Swamishri blessed some balaks who had come from Bhavnagar, saying, "Study properly. Attend the Bal Mandal. And obey your parents." The three fundamentals prescribed by Swamishri are beacons for all children to excel and progress in mundane and spiritual things.
Swamishri sanctified an ambulance donated by Dr. Sudhirbhai Patel (Bryan, USA) for the hospital in Dabhoi.

An assembly for the inauguration of a 2,000 litre water tank constructed by BAPS for Mahelav village was held in the mandir hall. Shri Narottambhai Patel, Minister for Water and Supplies, addressed the assembly. Finally, Swamishri blessed the assembly. At 9.00 a.m., Swamishri and Shri Narottambhai inaugurated amidst Vedic chantings 'Yagnapurush Varigruh'. Thereafter, Shri Narottambhai unveiled the plaque declaring the village square as 'Pramukh Swami Maharaj Chowk' and the main approach road into the village as 'Shastriji Maharaj Marg'.

In the morning the former Deputy Prime Minister of India Shri Lalkrishna Advani met Swamishri and received his blessings. Thereafter Shri L.M.Singhvi, former ambassador of India to the UK, met Swamishri.

At 6.30 pm an assembly of dignitaries was held in the mandir hall. Swamishri blessed the congregation, “No matter what one’s faith be the teachings of the scriptures and great saints have always been about the attainment of moksha. If one follows them then one is a human being. An animal has no discrimination as to where to sit, how to raise its offsprings; whereas man has been endowed with the power of discrimination. To become an ideal man the Shikshapatri has given 212 aphorisms…”

Today Nanabhai was also among those who came for meetings. Since Pramukh Swami Maharaj had come here, he had remembered Nanabhai two or three times, but calling him kept being left out. Yesterday Swamishri gave an instruction: "Bring him tomorrow."

Swamishri said to this elderly Khoja devotee, "I remembered you yesterday and the day before. My blessings that God keeps your health good. I have heard that you come to the katha every evening, which is very good. My blessings that your health remains good and that, while doing bhajan, you reach God's abode."
Today Minaz Bhayani, a Khoja youth from Talaja, phoned Pramukh Swami Maharaj. Swamishri said, "Why have I not seen you?"
Minaz said, "I come every day. I was to come for a meeting today, but I have a cold, so I could not come."
Swamishri said, "I am happy that you people have preserved satsang. My blessings that satsang keeps growing."
Minaz said, "Please keep your gaze of grace on us."
Swamishri said, "Your family has the grace of Yogi Bapa and Shastriji Maharaj. Such seva of all of you cannot be forgotten."

Today Nanabhai too came for a meeting. Since Pramukh Swami Maharaj came here, he had remembered Nanabhai two or three times, but calling him kept getting left out. Yesterday Swamishri gave instructions, "Bring him tomorrow."

Swamishri said to this elderly Khoja devotee, "I remembered you yesterday and the day before. My blessings are that Bhagwan keeps you in good health. I have heard that you come to the katha every evening, that is very good. My blessings are that your health remains good and that, doing bhajan, you reach Bhagwan's abode."
A Khoja youth named Minaz Bhayani of Talaja phoned Pramukh Swami Maharaj today. Swamishri said, "Why are you not to be seen?"
Minaz said, "I come every day. Today I was to come for a meeting, but I have a cold, so I could not come."
Swamishri said, "I am happy that you people have kept up the satsang. My blessings are that the satsang keeps growing."
Minaz said, "Please keep your grace upon us."
Swamishri said, "Yogi Bapa and Shastriji Maharaj have their grace upon your family. All of you have done such seva that it cannot be forgotten."

ds.t: We do what we are taught
w: Today, after performing the pratishtha of the abhishek murti of Ghanshyam Maharaj, Mahant Swami Maharaj sat just outside the "Abhishek Mandapam," on the side facing the mandir. The sadhus requested, "Please give blessings with both hands raised."
The simple natured Swamishri, laughing, raised both hands in the gesture of blessing and blessed everyone with both hands, like Yogi Bapa.
Then, taking the microphone, Swamishri said, "Yogi Bapa did it naturally, and we do what we have been taught."
Swamishri never misses a single chance to remember his gurus.
